distance_column.description: free_fall: distance fallen from release (m); exactly one of distance_column/height_column

height_column.description: free_fall: alias of distance_column (drop height measured from release, m)

sigma_column.description: free_fall: positive distance uncertainties; when absent errors are scaled from scatter

amplitude_deg.description: pendulum: single release amplitude in degrees for the finite-amplitude correction; mutually exclusive with amplitude_column

amplitude_column.description: pendulum: per-point amplitude column in degrees [0, 180)

sigma_current_column.description: ohms_law: positive current uncertainties, folded into an effective voltage uncertainty with the fitted R

model.description: free_fall: half_g_t_squared | with_initial_velocity (default) | full; pendulum: through_origin (default) | with_intercept; ohms_law: through_origin | with_intercept (default)

reference_g.description: free_fall/pendulum: reference g (m/s²); mutually exclusive with latitude_deg/altitude_m

latitude_deg.description: free_fall/pendulum: latitude for the WGS84 local-g reference

altitude_m.description: free_fall/pendulum: altitude for the WGS84 local-g reference (requires latitude_deg)

reference_resistance.description: ohms_law: reference resistance (Ω) for the z-score
